summary: Acceptance plan for warehouse allocation feature ensuring atomic reservation, priority handling, idempotency, and immutability.

requirements.description: Reserve all lines of an order together or reserve nothing, aggregating repeated SKU lines before checking stock.

sources.quote: Reserve all lines of an order together or reserve nothing; repeated SKU lines must be added together before checking stock.

acceptance.given: An initial stock map and an order with multiple or repeated line items
acceptance.when: A reservation is evaluated against current inventory
acceptance.then: All line quantities are aggregated and deducted atomically if sufficient stock exists; otherwise, no stock is deducted and an insufficient_stock error is returned

requirements.description: Process expedited orders before normal orders, preserving arrival order within each priority tier.

sources.quote: Expedited orders get stock before normal orders; preserve arrival order within each priority.

acceptance.given: A list of orders with expedited and normal priorities
acceptance.when: The orders are fulfilled against available stock
acceptance.then: All expedited orders are evaluated in their arrival order before any normal orders are evaluated in their arrival order

requirements.description: Process only the first occurrence of an order ID and ignore later occurrences.

sources.quote: An order ID is idempotent: process only its first occurrence and ignore later duplicates.

acceptance.given: A sequence of orders containing duplicate order IDs
acceptance.then: Only the first occurrence of any order ID is processed, and subsequent occurrences with that ID are completely ignored

requirements.description: Reject orders with invalid lines or parameters without mutating input objects or altering stock.

sources.quote: Invalid order lines must be rejected without changing stock, and callers must retain their original input objects.

acceptance.given: Invalid order lines or ill-formed orders alongside existing stock
acceptance.when: Reservation or order fulfillment is attempted
acceptance.then: The invalid items are rejected with appropriate error reasons without mutating input objects or modifying stock

assumptions: Stock is represented as a plain object mapping non-empty SKU string keys to non-negative safe integers.
Order lines are arrays of objects with non-empty string sku and positive safe-integer quantity properties.
Order IDs must be non-empty exact strings; missing or non-string IDs are rejected with id null and reason invalid_order.
An order with a first-seen valid ID but an invalid priority is rejected with reason invalid_order and claims the ID.
Invalid order rejections are recorded in input order, followed by reservation failures in execution order.
